description: A credential word narrows what a literal is for and does not decide what it is. The three positives preserve a signing key under exact, suffixed and camel-case compound configuration names. The negatives reproduce both measured failures: healthchecks' email_password_status holds the closed status word success for a CSS class, and pdfjs' ideographicsecretcircle is an Adobe glyph name whose numeric value is not a credential. The exact password/success pair proves the value check is independent of the identifier boundary check.

expected.note: an exact signing-key role and a value capable of serving in it
a suffixed compound key remains a signing-key role
camel case supplies the same identifier boundary as an underscore
